---
title: "Module 02 — State versus process"
---

## The problem

```
Process dies
     │
     ▼
What happens to Pico state?
```

## Native (volatile) baseline

With `NativeRuntime`, state lives only in memory. Restart the process and the count is gone.

## Durable requirement

Entity lifetime and process lifetime are **different concerns**.

| Concept | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| Volatile state | Lost when the process ends |
| Durable state | Survives process restart |
| Runtime lifecycle | Start / stop of the executor |
| Entity lifecycle | Logical lifetime of the Pico |

## Exercise

1. Invoke Hello Pico twice on `NativeRuntime`.
2. Create a **new** `NativeRuntime` instance (simulating restart).
3. Observe that state is gone.
4. Contrast with Module 07 (Durable State).
